impacts.text: When a user attempts to withdraw an amount close to `totalAssets`, the rounded-up `deduct` value can exceed the rounded-down `square(s)`, causing `sub(PCMath.square(s), deduct)` to underflow and revert.
Users who attempt to withdraw all or nearly all assets from a vault using `previewWithdraw` can experience unexpected reverts

ambiguities: MultiVault withdrawal flow being affected is explanatory context, not a distinct stated harm
